description_en: If you want to protect your Global Accelerator (GA) applications from large-scale DDoS attacks and ensure service stability and availability, you can call the AttachDdosToAccelerator operation to associate an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance with a GA instance
description_zh: 如果您想让全球加速的应用不受大规模DDoS攻击的影响，确保服务的稳定性和可用性，您可以调用AttachDdosToAccelerator接口将DDoS高防实例与全球加速实例绑定
kebab_example: aliyun ga attach-ddos-to-accelerator --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDdosToAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance with which you want to associate the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定DDoS高防实例的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to associate with the Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定到全球加速实例的DDoS高防实例ID
parameters.name: ddos_id

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例所在的地域，取值：

cn-hangzhou：中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：非中国内地
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to associate with the Global Accelerator (GA) instance
fields.help_zh: 绑定到全球加速实例的ddos高防实例id
fields.name: ddos_id

fields.help_en:
The region of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
fields.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例所在的地域，取值：

parameters.help_en: The list of Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to associate with the Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 与全球加速实例绑定的DDoS高防实例列表
parameters.name: ddos_config_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without actually associating the instances. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned.

false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会进行绑定。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

DdosId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance associated with the Global Accelerator (GA) instance
DdosId.description_zh: 绑定到全球加速实例的DDoS高防实例ID

GaId.description_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance with which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance is associated
GaId.description_zh: 绑定了DDoS高防实例的全球加速实例ID
